en.settings_proxy_desc: Manage in-app HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies
en.proxy_auto_switch_desc: Switch to the next saved proxy when a request fails
en.proxy_video_cdn_desc: Match video.twimg.com and its subdomains. When enabled, MP4 requests always use the selected in-app proxy, regardless of system VPN detection. Retry playback after enabling. HLS uses the system network.
en.proxy_video_requires_server: Add an in-app proxy server first

en.proxy_socks5_unsupported: SOCKS5 requires HarmonyOS 7 / API 26 or later

en.settings_grok_desc: Manage the Grok web page and built-in API
en.settings_grok_intro: Choose how Grok opens from a post. Web mode uses the official Grok website; API mode uses your own xAI API configuration.
en.settings_grok_mode_web_note: Open grok.com in the app and try to bring the current post's text and link into the Grok webpage. Sign-in and usage are managed by the official website.
en.settings_grok_mode_api_note: Send the current post to the xAI API as context and show the genuine reply in the app.
en.settings_grok_x_session_desc: Write the current account's X web session into ArkWeb before opening Grok. Selecting Sign in with X in Grok can then continue the official flow; no X credential is sent to grok.com.
en.settings_grok_api_key_note: Stored only on this device and used only for api.x.ai. Web mode does not require an API key.
en.settings_grok_mode_save_failed: Could not save the Grok mode
en.grok_context_hint: This post will be sent to Grok as context when you ask a question.
en.grok_not_configured: In Settings > Translation & AI, select Grok, enable API mode, and enter an xAI API key.
en.grok_web_mode_hint: Opening grok.com with the current post as a webpage request parameter. If this Grok web version does not prefill it, paste the post link into Grok's composer.
en.grok_web_prompt_prefix: Analyze this X post, using its text and link as context:
